会话存储迁移进行到一半：旧的签名 cookie 还在读，新会话已经双写到 Redis 测试实例。压测在 2000 并发下 p99 是 41 毫秒，比现在慢 6 毫秒，主要花在序列化上，换成 MessagePack 之后应该能追回来。回滚开关放在 SESSION_BACKEND 环境变量里，默认还是 cookie，W2 答复之前不会切。

web#2.author: lane-auth · sign-in flow
web#2.if_no_answer: keep cookies and ship on Thursday

options.label: Keep signed cookies
options.body: Zero new infra. Revoking means rotating the signing key — everyone signs out.

options.label: Move sessions to Redis
options.body: About a day of work plus a small Redis instance. Per-device sign-out comes for free.

meta.text: إن لم تُجب: keep cookies and ship on Thursday (قابل للتراجع)

body_rows.text: **What** The new sign-in screen is done (screenshot below). Before rollout I need to know where sessions live.
**Why now** Rate limiting (W3) and the rollout both depend on it.
- Cookies: no new infrastructure, sessions can't be revoked one by one
- Redis: instant revoke and "sign out everywhere", one more service to run

web#2.description:
**What** The new sign-in screen is done (screenshot below). Before rollout I need to know where sessions live.

**Why now** Rate limiting (W3) and the rollout both depend on it.

- Cookies: no new infrastructure, sessions can't be revoked one by one
- Redis: instant revoke and "sign out everywhere", one more service to run

### 1 · Keep signed cookies
Zero new infra. Revoking means rotating the signing key — everyone signs out.

### 2 · Move sessions to Redis
About a day of work plus a small Redis instance. Per-device sign-out comes for free.
